en.intro: Someone took Venetia's deadline a little too literally.
aanwijzingen: A · Alice (♀ woman): Was in the left half. Was in the 2nd row.
B · Beth (♀ woman): There was also someone with glasses in their room.

D · Dexter (♂ man): Was somewhere above Alice.
E · Eric (♂ man): Was in the 5th row. Was alone in the kitchenette.
V · Venetia (♀ woman): the victim. The murderer is the only suspect in the same room.
en.regels: one person per row and per column · "next to" = directly above/below/left/right, in the same room · nobody can be on blocked objects (⊘) · the victim has no clue · attributes (♂ man, ♀ woman, glasses, hat) follow each name; when counting "in total", the person themselves and the victim are included.
en.dader: The murderer is Dexter (D). The victim, Venetia, lay at the reception desk.
